title: PRO 2 yakuniy imtihon
goal_uz: Dars oxirida PRO 2 modulining asosiy mavzularini takrorlaysiz: muzokara va ish yozishmalari, kasbiy lug‘at, tarjima va diplomatik til, imtihon strategiyalari; yakuniy loyiha uchun reja tuzasiz va 15 savollik test topshirasiz.

vocab.uz: yolg‘on do‘st (shakli o‘xshash, ma’nosi boshqa so‘z)

scenes.title: PRO 2 yakuniy darsi
board: Muzokara · yozishma · kasbiy lug‘at · tarjima · strategiya
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum va tabriklayman: siz PRO 2 modulining oxirgi darsidasiz! Oldingi darsda portfolio va karyera rejasini tuzdik. Bugun butun modulni takrorlaymiz va yakuniy loyiha hamda test uchun tayyorlanamiz. Dars to‘rt qismdan iborat: muzokara va ish yozishmalari, kasbiy sohalar lug‘ati, tarjima va diplomatik til, rasmiy imtihon strategiyalari. Har qismda qisqa vaqtli mashq bo‘ladi, xuddi imtihondagidek. Dars oxirida siz o‘zingizni baholaysiz, yakuniy loyiha rejasini tuzasiz va o‘n besh savollik testni topshirasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to the final lesson of PRO 2, and congratulations on getting this far. Last time we built your portfolio and career plan. Today we review the whole module in four blocks: negotiation and business writing, professional vocabulary, translation and diplomacy, and exam strategies. Each block has a short timed task, just like a real exam.
scenes.say_uz: PRO 2 ning oxirgi darsiga xush kelibsiz, bu yergacha yetib kelganingiz bilan tabriklayman. O‘tgan safar portfolio va karyera rejasini qurdik. Bugun butun modulni to‘rt blokda takrorlaymiz: muzokara va ish yozishmalari, kasbiy lug‘at, tarjima va diplomatiya, imtihon strategiyalari. Har blokda haqiqiy imtihondagidek qisqa vaqtli topshiriq bor.

scenes.title: Muzokara tili
board: Trade concessions, never give them free

examples.t: If you can commit to a two-year contract, we would be able to reduce the unit price.
examples.uz: Ikki yillik shartnomaga rozi bo‘lsangiz, birlik narxini pasaytira olamiz.

examples.t: We could consider that, provided delivery is guaranteed within ten days.
examples.uz: Buni ko‘rib chiqishimiz mumkin, agar yetkazib berish o‘n kun ichida kafolatlansa.

examples.t: So, to summarise, we agree on price and timing, and we will revisit insurance next week.
examples.uz: Xulosa qilsak, narx va muddat bo‘yicha kelishdik, sug‘urtani kelasi hafta qayta ko‘rib chiqamiz.

scenes.say_native: Muzokaraga tayyorgarlik uch narsadan iborat: maqsad, chegara va muqobil, ya’ni „BATNA“ — agar kelishuv bo‘lmasa, eng yaxshi muqobil yo‘l. Muzokarada asosiy tuzilma — shartli gap: „If you can commit to a two-year contract, we would be able to reduce the unit price“. Yon berishni hech qachon bepul bermang, ayirboshlang: „We could consider that, provided delivery is guaranteed within ten days“. „Provided“ — agar shart bajarilsa. Oxirida kelishuvni umumlashtiring: „So, to summarise…“. Bu birinchi va ikkinchi shartli gaplar bilan o‘tgan darslarda ishlagan edik. O‘zbek madaniyatidagi cho‘zilgan odob muzokarada ko‘pincha aniq shartlarni yashiradi, inglizcha tilda esa muloyim, lekin aniq bo‘lish kerak.
scenes.say: Prepare three things: your goal, your limit and your alternative if there is no deal. The key structure is the conditional: if you can commit to a two-year contract, we would be able to reduce the unit price. Never give a concession for free. Trade it: we could consider that, provided delivery is guaranteed within ten days. At the end, summarise: so, to summarise, we agree on price and timing.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta narsani tayyorlang: maqsad, chegara va kelishuv bo‘lmasa muqobil. Asosiy tuzilma — shartli gap. Yon berishni bepul bermang, ayirboshlang. Oxirida kelishuvni umumlashtiring.

scenes.title: Xato: muzokaradagi odatiy xatolar
board: ✓ At this stage, the best we can offer is…

examples.t: At this stage, the best we can offer is a five per cent discount.
examples.uz: Hozirgi bosqichda taklif qila oladigan eng yaxshi narsamiz — besh foiz chegirma.

examples.t: I will need to check that with my director before I can confirm.
examples.uz: Tasdiqlashdan oldin buni direktorim bilan tekshirishim kerak.

scenes.say_native: Muzokaradagi uchta xato. Birinchisi — juda erta „This is our final price“ deyish: bu eshikni yopadi. Aniqrog‘i: „At this stage, the best we can offer is five per cent“. Ikkinchisi — darhol rozi bo‘lish. Tez rozilik taklifingiz ancha pastroq bo‘lganini ko‘rsatadi va keyingi yon berishlarni ham talab qiladi. Vaqt oling: „I will need to check that with my director before I can confirm“. Uchinchisi — to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri „No, impossible“. Buning o‘rniga muqobil taklif qiling: „That would be difficult for us, but what if we…“. Muzokarada „no“ so‘zi ham, shoshilinch „yes“ ham xavfli.
scenes.say: Three negotiation mistakes. First, announcing this is our final price too early, which closes the door. Say: at this stage, the best we can offer is five per cent. Second, agreeing immediately, which invites more demands. Buy time: I will need to check that with my director before I can confirm. Third, a flat no. Say: that would be difficult for us, but what if we split the cost?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta xato. Erta final price deyish eshikni yopadi. Darhol rozi bo‘lish yana talablarga yo‘l ochadi, vaqt oling. To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri yo‘q demang, muqobil taklif qiling.

scenes.title: Mashq: muzokarada javob bering
board: Supplier: We cannot reduce the price below 120 per unit.
You want 105 and an order of 5,000 units.
scenes.say_native: Yetkazib beruvchi aytadi: „Narxni bir birlik uchun yuz yigirmadan pasaytira olmaymiz.“ Siz yuz beshni xohlaysiz va besh ming birlik buyurtma berasiz. Yon berishni ayirboshlab javob bering: shartli gap va „provided“ dan foydalaning. Yigirma soniya. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: The supplier says: we cannot reduce the price below one hundred and twenty per unit. You want one hundred and five and you can order five thousand units. Respond by trading a concession. Use a conditional and the word provided. You have twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Yetkazib beruvchi: narxni bir birlik uchun yuz yigirmadan pasaytira olmaymiz. Siz yuz besh xohlaysiz va besh ming birlik buyurtma bera olasiz. Yon berishni ayirboshlab javob bering, shartli gap va provided ishlating. Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Javob: muzokara namunasi
board: If we increase the order to 5,000, would you consider 105?

examples.t: If we commit to five thousand units, would you consider one hundred and five, provided we pay within thirty days?
examples.uz: Besh ming birlikka majburiyat olsak, o‘ttiz kun ichida to‘lash sharti bilan yuz beshni ko‘rib chiqasizmi?

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „I understand your position. However, if we commit to five thousand units, would you consider one hundred and five, provided we pay within thirty days?“ Tuzilma: avval tushunishni bildirish, keyin shartli taklif. Yon berish — hajm va tezkor to‘lov, evaziga narx. „Would you consider“ — ko‘rib chiqasizmi, savol shaklidagi yumshoq taklif. Bu javob to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri talab qilmaydi, lekin narxni aniq ko‘rsatadi. Agar sizning javobingizda shart va evaz bo‘lsa, muzokara mantig‘i to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: A model answer. I understand your position. However, if we commit to five thousand units, would you consider one hundred and five, provided we pay within thirty days? First show understanding, then make a conditional proposal. Volume and fast payment are the concessions, and the price is what you ask in return. Would you consider keeps the request polite but clear.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Pozitsiyangizni tushunaman. Biroq, besh ming birlikka majburiyat olsak, o‘ttiz kun ichida to‘lash sharti bilan yuz beshni ko‘rib chiqasizmi? Avval tushunishni bildiring, keyin shartli taklif qiling. Hajm va tez to‘lov yon berish, narx esa evaz.

scenes.title: Ish yozishmalari

examples.t: Subject: Contract draft for review by Friday
examples.uz: Mavzu: Shartnoma loyihasi juma kunigacha ko‘rib chiqish uchun

examples.t: I am writing to confirm the dates for the site visit.
examples.uz: Ob’ektga tashrif sanalarini tasdiqlash uchun yozyapman.

examples.t: Could you let me have your comments by Friday, so that we can sign on Monday?
examples.uz: Dushanba kuni imzolashimiz uchun fikrlaringizni juma kunigacha yubora olasizmi?

scenes.say_native: Yaxshi ish xati to‘rt qismdan iborat. Mavzu satri aniq va harakatga chaqirsin: „Contract draft for review by Friday“. Birinchi gap yozish maqsadini aytsin: „I am writing to confirm the dates for the site visit“. Asosiy xulosa avval, tafsilotlar keyin keladi, chunki o‘quvchi vaqti kam. Oxirida keyingi qadam va muddat: „Could you let me have your comments by Friday, so that we can sign on Monday?“ Salomlashishda „Dear Mr Karim“, yakunda „Kind regards“. Ingliz biznes xatlari qisqa va aniq, o‘zbekcha rasmiy xatlardagi uzun kirish va maqtovlar bu yerda ortiqcha hisoblanadi.
scenes.say: A good business email has four parts. A specific subject line with an action: contract draft for review by Friday. An opening that states the purpose: I am writing to confirm the dates for the site visit. The main point comes first, details follow. Close with the next step and a deadline: could you let me have your comments by Friday, so that we can sign on Monday?
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi ish xati to‘rt qismdan iborat: aniq va harakatga chaqiruvchi mavzu, maqsadni aytuvchi ochilish, avval asosiy fikr keyin tafsilot, va keyingi qadam bilan muddat bilan yakun.

scenes.title: Xato: noaniq va haddan tashqari rasmiy xat
board: ✓ Subject: Delay to order 4471 – action needed
✗ I hope this email finds you in good health…

examples.t: Subject: Delay to order 4471, action needed by Thursday
examples.uz: Mavzu: 4471-buyurtmaning kechikishi, payshanbagacha harakat kerak

examples.t: Please confirm by noon on Thursday whether we can ship on Friday.
examples.uz: Juma kuni yuborishimiz mumkinligini payshanba tushigacha tasdiqlang.

scenes.say_native: Ish yozishmalarida uchta xato bor. Birinchisi — „Subject: Hello“ yoki bo‘sh mavzu. Xat ochilmay qolishi mumkin. Aniqrog‘i: „Delay to order 4471 – action needed by Thursday“. Ikkinchisi — uzun, ortiqcha kirish: „I hope this email finds you in good health“. Qisqa va to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri yozing. Uchinchisi — „ASAP“ va „urgent!!!“: bu bosim sifatida eshitiladi va aniq muddat o‘rniga turadi. Yaxshisi: „Please confirm by noon on Thursday“. O‘zbek ish yozishmalarida ko‘pincha odob uchun uzoq kirish yoziladi, inglizcha ish uslubida esa aniqlik hurmat belgisi hisoblanadi.
scenes.say: Three email mistakes. A vague subject line like hello, which may never be opened. Use: delay to order 4471, action needed by Thursday. A long, empty opening such as I hope this email finds you in good health. Get to the point. And ASAP or urgent with exclamation marks, which sounds like pressure. Give a real deadline: please confirm by noon on Thursday.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta xato. Noaniq mavzu, uni aniq va harakatli qiling. Uzun bo‘sh kirish o‘rniga to‘g‘ri mavzuga o‘ting. ASAP va urgent o‘rniga haqiqiy muddat bering.

scenes.title: Mashq: xat yozing
board: Situation: the workshop on 12 May must move to 19 May because of a venue problem.
scenes.say_native: Vaziyat: o‘n ikkinchi maydagi seminar joy muammosi tufayli o‘n to‘qqizinchi mayga ko‘chirilishi kerak. Mavzu satri va uch gaplik xatni ayting. Oxirida chorshanbagacha tasdiq so‘rang. Muloyim, lekin aniq bo‘ling. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: The workshop on the twelfth of May must move to the nineteenth because of a venue problem. Give a subject line and a three-sentence email. Ask for confirmation by Wednesday. Be polite but precise.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n ikkinchi maydagi seminar joy muammosi tufayli o‘n to‘qqizinchi mayga ko‘chirilishi kerak. Mavzu satri va uch gaplik xatni ayting. Chorshanbagacha tasdiq so‘rang. Muloyim, lekin aniq bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Javob: xat namunasi
board: Subject: Workshop moved to 19 May – please confirm
I am writing to let you know…

examples.t: I am writing to let you know that, owing to a venue problem, the workshop will now take place on the nineteenth of May.
examples.uz: Joy muammosi tufayli seminar endi o‘n to‘qqizinchi mayda bo‘lib o‘tishini ma’lum qilish uchun yozyapman.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy xat: mavzu — „Workshop moved to 19 May – please confirm“. Matn: „I am writing to let you know that, owing to a venue problem, the workshop will now take place on the nineteenth of May instead of the twelfth. I apologise for any inconvenience this may cause. Could you confirm by Wednesday whether you can attend on the new date?“ „Owing to“ — tufayli, „take place“ — bo‘lib o‘tmoq, „inconvenience“ — noqulaylik. Uch gap: xabar, uzr va aniq iltimos. Mavzu satrida harakat bor: „please confirm“. Sizning xatingizda yangi sana, uzr va muddatli iltimos bo‘lsa, mashq bajarilgan.
scenes.say: A model email. Subject: workshop moved to the nineteenth of May, please confirm. I am writing to let you know that, owing to a venue problem, the workshop will now take place on the nineteenth of May instead of the twelfth. I apologise for any inconvenience. Could you confirm by Wednesday whether you can attend on the new date? The email gives the news, an apology and a clear request.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy xat. Mavzu: seminar o‘n to‘qqizinchi mayga ko‘chirildi, iltimos tasdiqlang. Joy muammosi tufayli seminar o‘n ikkinchi may o‘rniga o‘n to‘qqizinchi mayda bo‘lib o‘tishini ma’lum qilaman. Noqulaylik uchun uzr. Yangi sanada qatnasha olishingizni chorshanbagacha tasdiqlay olasizmi?

scenes.title: Kasbiy sohalar lug‘ati
board: Finance: assets · liabilities · equity · cash flow

examples.t: The company’s liabilities exceeded its assets, so it faced a cash-flow crisis.
examples.uz: Kompaniya majburiyatlari aktivlaridan oshib ketdi, shuning uchun pul oqimi inqiroziga uchradi.

examples.t: If either party commits a breach of this clause, the contract may be terminated.
examples.uz: Tomonlardan biri ushbu bandni buzsa, shartnoma bekor qilinishi mumkin.

examples.t: The patient was referred to a specialist for further diagnosis.
examples.uz: Bemor keyingi tashxis uchun mutaxassisga yuborildi.

scenes.say_native: Kasbiy lug‘atni so‘z ro‘yxati sifatida emas, kollokatsiya va gap ichida o‘rganing. Moliya: „assets“ — aktivlar, „liabilities“ — majburiyatlar, „equity“ — kapitaldagi ulush, „cash flow“ — pul oqimi. Huquq: „clause“ — shartnoma bandi, „breach“ — buzish, „liability“ bu yerda — javobgarlik, „jurisdiction“ — yurisdiksiya. E’tibor bering: „liability“ moliyada majburiyat, huquqda esa javobgarlik. Tibbiyot: „diagnosis“ — tashxis, „symptoms“ — belgilar, „referral“ — boshqa mutaxassisga yo‘llanma. Texnologiya: „deploy“ — ishga tushirmoq, „scalable“ — kengaytirsa bo‘ladigan, „latency“ — kechikish. Bitta so‘z sohaga qarab ma’no o‘zgartiradi, shuning uchun har doim kontekstni o‘ylang.
scenes.say: Learn professional vocabulary in collocations, not lists. Finance: assets, liabilities, equity and cash flow. Law: clause, breach, liability and jurisdiction. Notice that liability means a debt in finance but legal responsibility in law. Medicine: diagnosis, symptoms, treatment and referral. Technology: deploy, scalable, bug and latency. One word can change meaning with the field, so always think about context.
scenes.say_uz: Kasbiy lug‘atni ro‘yxat emas, kollokatsiya sifatida o‘rganing. Moliya, huquq, tibbiyot va texnologiya so‘zlarini ko‘rdik. Liability moliyada majburiyat, huquqda javobgarlik. Bitta so‘z sohaga qarab ma’no o‘zgartiradi, shuning uchun kontekstni o‘ylang.

scenes.title: Mashq: so‘zni kontekstda tanlang
board: 1) The firm’s ___ now exceed its assets. (liabilities / symptoms)
2) The doctor made a quick ___. (clause / diagnosis)
3) If you ___ the contract, you may be sued. (breach / deploy)
scenes.say_native: Har bir gapdagi bo‘sh o‘ringa mos so‘zni tanlang. Birinchi: firmaning majburiyatlari aktivlaridan oshdi, majburiyatlar yoki belgilar. Ikkinchi: shifokor tez tashxis qo‘ydi. Uchinchi: shartnomani buzsangiz, sudga berilishingiz mumkin. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Choose the right word for each gap. One: the firm's liabilities or symptoms now exceed its assets. Two: the doctor made a quick clause or diagnosis. Three: if you breach or deploy the contract, you may be sued.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir bo‘sh o‘ringa mos so‘zni tanlang. Bir: firmaning majburiyatlari yoki belgilari aktivlaridan oshdi. Ikki: shifokor tez bandni yoki tashxisni qo‘ydi. Uch: shartnomani buzsangiz yoki ishga tushirsangiz, sudga berilishingiz mumkin.

scenes.title: Javoblar: kontekstli lug‘at

examples.t: If you breach the contract, you may be sued.
examples.uz: Shartnomani buzsangiz, sudga berilishingiz mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: „liabilities“, chunki aktivlar bilan majburiyatlar solishtiriladi. „Symptoms“ tibbiyotga tegishli va bu yerda ma’nosiz. Ikkinchi: „diagnosis“, shifokor tashxis qo‘yadi; „clause“ shartnoma bandi. Uchinchi: „breach“. „Breach the contract“ — shartnomani buzmoq, kuchli kollokatsiya. „Deploy“ dasturni ishga tushirishga tegishli. E’tibor bering, har bir to‘g‘ri javobni sohasi va birga keladigan so‘zlari ko‘rsatdi: „assets“, „doctor“, „sued“. Imtihonda noma’lum so‘z ko‘rsangiz, atrofdagi so‘zlardan ma’nosini taxmin qilish — eng foydali ko‘nikma.
scenes.say: One: liabilities, because it is compared with assets. Two: diagnosis, because a doctor makes it. Three: breach. Breach the contract is a strong collocation. Each answer was signalled by nearby words: assets, doctor and sued. In an exam, guessing the meaning of an unknown word from context is one of the most useful skills.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: liabilities, chunki aktivlar bilan solishtiriladi. Ikki: diagnosis, uni shifokor qo‘yadi. Uch: breach, breach the contract kuchli kollokatsiya. Har javobni yaqin so‘zlar ko‘rsatdi: assets, doctor, sued. Imtihonda noma’lum so‘zni kontekstdan taxmin qilish juda foydali.

scenes.title: Tarjima va diplomatiya

examples.t: Not: I am agree. But: I agree.
examples.uz: ‘I am agree’ emas, ‘I agree’.

examples.t: The proposal is interesting, but we have some reservations.
examples.uz: Taklif qiziq, lekin bizda ba’zi e’tirozlar bor.

examples.t: It seems there may have been a misunderstanding.
examples.uz: Ehtimol, tushunmovchilik yuz bergan ko‘rinadi.

scenes.say_native: Tarjimada so‘zlarni emas, ma’noni o‘tkazing. O‘zbek tilidan so‘zma-so‘z kalka xatolari ko‘p: „I am agree“ emas, „I agree“. „Men sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qildim“ ni „I called to you“ deb emas, „I called you“ deb tarjima qiling. Ikkinchi mavzu — yolg‘on do‘stlar. Masalan „actual“ inglizchada „haqiqiy“ degani, „hozirgi“ emas, hozirgi uchun „current“. Diplomatiyada qat’iy gap yumshatiladi: „We have some reservations“ — bizda ba’zi e’tirozlar bor, „It seems there may have been a misunderstanding“. Maqsad — fikrni aniq saqlab, hurmatni yo‘qotmaslik. Uslub ham muhim: rasmiy xatda „request“, oddiy gapda „ask“.
scenes.say: When you translate, carry the meaning, not the words. Avoid calques from your first language: not I am agree, but I agree. Beware of false friends. Actual in English means real, not current. For current, say current. In diplomacy, soften firm statements: we have some reservations, or it seems there may have been a misunderstanding. The goal is to keep the message clear while preserving respect.
scenes.say_uz: Tarjimada so‘zlarni emas, ma’noni o‘tkazing. Ona tilidan so‘zma-so‘z kalkalardan saqlaning: I am agree emas, I agree. Yolg‘on do‘stlardan ehtiyot bo‘ling: actual — haqiqiy, current — hozirgi. Diplomatiyada qat’iy gaplarni yumshating, lekin ma’noni aniq saqlang.

scenes.title: Xato: tarjimadagi kalkalar va qattiq ohang
board: ✗ I will make a call to you.

examples.t: I see it slightly differently. May I explain why?
examples.uz: Men buni biroz boshqacha ko‘raman. Sababini tushuntirsam bo‘ladimi?

examples.t: Could you clarify what you mean by priority?
examples.uz: Priority deganda nimani nazarda tutayotganingizni aniqlashtira olasizmi?

scenes.say_native: Ikki xato guruhi bor. Birinchisi — kalkalar. „I will make a call to you“ — yodlangan so‘zma-so‘z shakl; to‘g‘risi „I will call you“. „He has a big experience“ emas, „He has a lot of experience“, chunki „experience“ sanalmaydi. Ikkinchisi — qattiq ohang: „Your idea is wrong“. Diplomatik muhitda bu eshikni yopadi. Yaxshisi: „I see it slightly differently. May I explain why?“ Yoki tushunmovchilikda: „Could you clarify what you mean by priority?“ Bunday gaplar qarama-qarshilik emas, hamkorlik ohangini beradi. O‘zbek tilidagi „yo‘q, bu noto‘g‘ri“ ni inglizchaga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri o‘tkazmang.
scenes.say: Two groups of mistakes. First, calques. I will make a call to you is a word-for-word form. Say: I will call you. Also, not he has a big experience, but he has a lot of experience, because experience is uncountable here. Second, harsh tone: your idea is wrong. Say: I see it slightly differently. May I explain why? Or: could you clarify what you mean by priority?
scenes.say_uz: Ikki guruh xato. Birinchi: kalkalar, I will make a call to you emas, I will call you. Experience bu yerda sanalmaydi. Ikkinchi: qattiq ohang, Your idea is wrong o‘rniga I see it slightly differently ayting.

scenes.title: Mashq: diplomatik tarjima
scenes.say_native: Uchta o‘zbekcha gapni inglizchaga diplomatik tarjima qiling. Birinchi: bizning narxlar sizning narxlaringizdan yaxshi. Ikkinchi: siz noto‘g‘ri hisobladingiz. Uchinchi: biz buni qabul qila olmaymiz. Ma’noni saqlang, lekin muloyim va yumshoq ayting. Javoblarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Translate three blunt Uzbek sentences into diplomatic English. One: our prices are better than yours. Two: you calculated it wrongly. Three: we cannot accept this. Keep the meaning, but make each one polite and softened.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta qo‘pol o‘zbekcha gapni diplomatik inglizchaga tarjima qiling. Bir: bizning narxlar sizning narxlaringizdan yaxshi. Ikki: siz noto‘g‘ri hisobladingiz. Uch: biz buni qabul qila olmaymiz. Ma’noni saqlang, lekin yumshoq va muloyim ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: diplomatik tarjima
board: 1) We believe our prices are quite competitive.
2) There may be a small error in the calculation.
3) Unfortunately, that would be difficult for us to accept.

examples.t: We believe our prices are highly competitive.
examples.uz: Bizningcha, narxlarimiz juda raqobatbardosh.

examples.t: There may be a small error in the calculation.
examples.uz: Hisob-kitobda kichik xato bo‘lishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: „We believe our prices are highly competitive“ — „raqobatbardosh“ solishtirishdan qochadi va hamkorni haqorat qilmaydi. Ikkinchi: „There may be a small error in the calculation“ — ayblovchi „you“ yo‘q, javobgarlik shaxsiy emas. Uchinchi: „Unfortunately, that would be difficult for us to accept“. „Unfortunately“ — afsuski, „would be difficult“ — qiyin bo‘lardi, bu rad etishni muloyim qiladi. Diplomatik tarjimaning uch usuli: shaxsiy „you“ ni olib tashlash, „may“ va „would“ ishlatish va qat’iy rad o‘rniga „difficult“ demoq. Ma’no saqlanadi, ohang esa o‘zgaradi.
scenes.say: One: we believe our prices are highly competitive. It avoids a direct comparison. Two: there may be a small error in the calculation. There is no accusing you, so responsibility is not personal. Three: unfortunately, that would be difficult for us to accept. Three techniques: remove the accusing you, use may and would, and say difficult instead of a flat no.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: narxlarimiz juda raqobatbardosh, to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri solishtirmaydi. Ikki: hisob-kitobda kichik xato bo‘lishi mumkin, aybdor ko‘rsatilmaydi. Uch: afsuski, buni qabul qilish biz uchun qiyin bo‘lardi. Uch usul: ayblovchi you ni olib tashlash, may va would ishlatish, yo‘q o‘rniga difficult deyish.

scenes.title: Rasmiy imtihon strategiyalari

examples.t: Skim the text for the main idea before you read the questions.
examples.uz: Savollarni o‘qishdan oldin matnning asosiy g‘oyasini tez ko‘zdan kechiring.

examples.t: The speaker first says Tuesday, but then changes it to Thursday.
examples.uz: Gapiruvchi avval seshanba deydi, keyin payshanbaga o‘zgartiradi.

examples.t: If you do not know an answer, eliminate two options and guess.
examples.uz: Javobni bilmasangiz, ikkita variantni chiqarib tashlab, taxmin qiling.

scenes.say_native: Eng muhim imtihon strategiyalari. O‘qishda: avval matnni tez ko‘zdan kechiring, ya’ni „skim“, asosiy g‘oyani toping; keyin savolni o‘qing; keyin kerakli joyni qidiring, ya’ni „scan“. Hamma so‘zni tushunish shart emas. Tinglashda: savollarni oldindan o‘qing va kalit so‘zlarni belgilang. Chalg‘ituvchi variantlar, ya’ni „distractors“, ko‘p: gapiruvchi avval „Tuesday“ deydi, keyin „Thursday“ ga o‘zgartiradi; to‘g‘ri javob oxirgisi. Yozishda: besh daqiqalik reja va uch daqiqalik tekshiruv. Gapirishda: javobni kengaytirish va vaqt yutish. Agar bilmasangiz, ikkita variantni chiqarib tashlab taxmin qiling; bo‘sh qoldirish ball bermaydi.
scenes.say: The key exam strategies. In reading, skim for the main idea, then read the question, then scan for the answer. You do not need to understand every word. In listening, read the questions first and underline keywords. Watch for distractors: a speaker says Tuesday, then changes it to Thursday, and the correct answer is the last one. If you do not know, eliminate two options and guess.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy strategiyalar. O‘qishda avval skim, keyin savol, keyin scan. Hamma so‘zni tushunish shart emas. Tinglashda savollarni oldindan o‘qing va chalg‘ituvchi variantlarga ehtiyot bo‘ling. Bilmasangiz, ikkita variantni chiqarib tashlab taxmin qiling.

scenes.title: Mock listening: yig‘ilish rejasi o‘zgardi
board: Q1: When is the new meeting?
scenes.say_native: Endi mock tinglash. Matnni bir marta tinglang. Uchta savol: yangi yig‘ilish qachon, kim taqdimot qiladi va qatnashuvchilar nima olib kelishi kerak? Chalg‘ituvchi ma’lumotlarga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Hi everyone, a quick update. The planning meeting was going to be on Tuesday, but the room is booked, so we will move it to Thursday at ten. Farid was going to present the budget, but he is travelling, so Alina will take over. Please bring last quarter's sales figures, not the forecast. Questions? No? Then see you on Thursday.
scenes.say_uz: Hammaga salom, qisqa yangilik. Rejalashtirish yig‘ilishi seshanba kuni bo‘lishi kerak edi, lekin xona band, shuning uchun payshanba soat o‘nga ko‘chiramiz. Byudjetni Farid taqdim qilishi kerak edi, lekin u safarda, shuning uchun Alina o‘rniga o‘tadi. Iltimos, prognozni emas, o‘tgan chorak sotuv ko‘rsatkichlarini olib keling. Savollar? Yo‘q? Unda payshanba kuni ko‘rishamiz.

scenes.title: Mashq: mock tinglash javoblari
board: Q1: When is the new meeting?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: yangi yig‘ilish qachon? Ikkinchi: kim taqdimot qiladi? Uchinchi: qatnashuvchilar nimani olib kelishi kerak? Chalg‘ituvchi variantlardan ehtiyot bo‘ling. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Answer three questions. When is the new meeting? Who will present? What must attendees bring? Watch out for distractors.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savolga javob bering. Yangi yig‘ilish qachon? Kim taqdimot qiladi? Qatnashuvchilar nimani olib kelishi kerak? Chalg‘ituvchi variantlardan ehtiyot bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Javoblar: mock tinglash
board: 3) Last quarter’s sales figures (not the forecast)

examples.t: Alina will take over the presentation from Farid.
examples.uz: Alina taqdimotni Fariddan o‘z zimmasiga oladi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: payshanba soat o‘nda, seshanba chalg‘ituvchi variant edi. Ikkinchi: Alina, Farid emas. „Take over“ — o‘z zimmasiga olmoq. Uchinchi: o‘tgan chorak sotuv ko‘rsatkichlari, prognoz emas. Uch savolda ham birinchi aytilgan variant noto‘g‘ri edi. Mana shu — „distractor“ naqshi. Kalit signal so‘zlar: „was going to“ — rejalashtirilgan edi, lekin bo‘lmadi; „but“ va „instead“. Bunday iboralarni eshitsangiz, keyingi ma’lumot ehtimol to‘g‘ri javob. Sizning uchta javobingiz to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, tinglash strategiyangiz ishlayapti.
scenes.say: One: Thursday at ten, and Tuesday was the distractor. Two: Alina, not Farid. Take over means to assume responsibility. Three: last quarter's sales figures, not the forecast. In all three, the first option mentioned was wrong. The signal phrases are was going to, but and instead. When you hear them, the next piece of information is probably the answer.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: payshanba soat o‘nda, seshanba chalg‘ituvchi edi. Ikki: Alina, Farid emas. Uch: o‘tgan chorak sotuv ko‘rsatkichlari, prognoz emas. Uchalasida ham birinchi aytilgani noto‘g‘ri edi. Signal iboralar: was going to, but, instead. Ularni eshitsangiz, keyingi ma’lumot ehtimol javob.

scenes.title: Yakuniy loyiha: hisobot va nutq rejasi
board: Topic: a proposal for your workplace
Say: problem · solution · cost/benefit · next step
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy loyiha uchun reja tuzing. Hisobot va to‘rt daqiqalik nutq ish joyingiz uchun taklif haqida bo‘lsin. Qirq soniyada ayting: muammo nima, yechim nima, xarajat va foyda qanday va keyingi qadam qanday. Muzokara va diplomatik tildan foydalaning. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Plan your final project, which is a report and a four-minute speech about a proposal for your workplace. In forty seconds, say what the problem is, what the solution is, what the cost and benefit are, and what the next step is. Use negotiation and diplomatic language.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy loyiha rejasini tuzing: ish joyingiz uchun taklif haqida hisobot va to‘rt daqiqalik nutq. Qirq soniyada muammo, yechim, xarajat va foyda hamda keyingi qadamni ayting. Muzokara va diplomatik tildan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Javob: loyiha rejasi namunasi

examples.t: I propose a digital onboarding guide, which would cost two thousand and save around a hundred and twenty working hours a year.
examples.uz: Raqamli kirish qo‘llanmasini taklif qilaman, u ikki ming turadi va yiliga taxminan yuz yigirma ish soatini tejaydi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy reja: „Currently, new employees take two weeks to become productive. I propose a digital onboarding guide, which would cost two thousand and save around a hundred and twenty working hours a year. I would suggest a pilot in March, and we can review the results in June.“ Tuzilma: muammo, yechim, xarajat-foyda, keyingi qadam. „Currently“ — hozirda, „pilot“ — sinov bosqichi, „I would suggest“ — yumshoq taklif. Raqamlar ishonchni oshiradi, shartli gap va diplomatik fe’l ohangni muloyim qiladi. Shu tuzilma hisobot ham, nutq ham uchun asos bo‘ladi, shuning uchun uyga vazifada undan foydalaning.
scenes.say: A model plan. Currently, new employees take two weeks to become productive. I propose a digital onboarding guide, which would cost two thousand and save around a hundred and twenty working hours a year. I would suggest a pilot in March, and we can review the results in June. This structure works for both a report and a speech.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy reja. Hozirda yangi xodimlar samarali bo‘lishi uchun ikki hafta oladi. Raqamli kirish qo‘llanmasini taklif qilaman, u ikki ming turadi va yiliga taxminan yuz yigirma ish soatini tejaydi. Martda sinov o‘tkazishni tavsiya qilaman, natijalarni iyunda ko‘ramiz. Bu tuzilma ham hisobot, ham nutq uchun mos.

scenes.title: Butun modul takrori
scenes.say_native: Modulni jamlaymiz. Muzokarada shartli gaplar bilan yon berishni ayirboshlang va oxirida kelishuvni umumlashtiring. Yozishmada aniq mavzu, maqsad, keyingi qadam va muddat bo‘lsin. Kasbiy lug‘atni kontekst va kollokatsiya bilan o‘rganing: bitta so‘z sohaga qarab ma’no o‘zgartiradi. Tarjimada kalkalardan saqlaning, yolg‘on do‘stlarni biling va gapni yumshating. Imtihonda skim va scan, chalg‘ituvchi variantlar, besh daqiqalik reja va javobni kengaytirish ishlaydi. Oldingi darslardagi liderlik, media, adabiy tahlil va portfolio ham shu bilan birga ishlaydi. Siz C1 darajasida professional ingliz tilida ishlashga tayyorsiz.
scenes.say: Let's review the module. In negotiation, trade concessions with conditionals and summarise at the end. In writing, use a clear subject, purpose, next step and deadline. Learn professional vocabulary in context. In translation, avoid calques, know your false friends and soften your language. In exams, skim and scan, watch for distractors, plan for five minutes and extend your answers. You are ready to work in professional English at C1 level.
scenes.say_uz: Modulni jamlaymiz. Muzokarada yon berishni shartli gaplar bilan ayirboshlang va oxirida umumlashtiring. Yozishmada aniq mavzu, maqsad, keyingi qadam va muddat bo‘lsin. Lug‘atni kontekstda o‘rganing. Tarjimada kalkalardan saqlaning va gapni yumshating. Imtihonda skim va scan, chalg‘ituvchilar, reja va javobni kengaytirish. Siz C1 darajasida professional ingliz tilida ishlashga tayyorsiz.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa va test
board: Final project: written report + 4-minute speech recording
Report: 500–600 words · problem · solution · cost/benefit · next step
Speech: 4 minutes · clear structure · diplomatic tone
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa: hisobot va to‘rt daqiqalik nutqni yozib oling. Hisobot besh yuz-olti yuz so‘zdan iborat bo‘lsin: muammo, yechim, xarajat va foyda, keyingi qadam. Nutq to‘rt daqiqa, aniq tuzilma va diplomatik ohang bilan. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: hisobotda raqamlar va shartli gaplar bor, nutqda kengaytirilgan javoblar, bog‘lovchilar va bitta ko‘prik iborasi bor. Shundan keyin o‘n besh savollik testni topshiring. Bu bilan PRO 2 moduli yakunlandi. Tabriklayman, siz katta yo‘lni bosib o‘tdingiz va endi inglizcha professional dunyoda ishonch bilan harakat qila olasiz.
scenes.say: Your final task is to write a report and record a four-minute speech. The report should be five hundred to six hundred words: problem, solution, cost and benefit, and next step. The speech should have a clear structure and a diplomatic tone. Then take the fifteen-question test. This completes PRO 2. Congratulations, and well done on your achievement.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy vazifa: hisobot yozing va to‘rt daqiqalik nutqni yozib oling. Hisobot besh yuz-olti yuz so‘z: muammo, yechim, xarajat va foyda, keyingi qadam. Nutq aniq tuzilma va diplomatik ohangda bo‘lsin. Keyin o‘n besh savollik testni topshiring. Shu bilan PRO 2 yakunlandi. Tabriklayman!

homework_uz: Yakuniy loyiha: ish joyingiz uchun taklif haqida 500–600 so‘zli hisobot (muammo, yechim, xarajat va foyda, keyingi qadam) yozing va to‘rt daqiqalik nutqni yozib oling. Hisobotda raqamlar va shartli gaplar, nutqda aniq tuzilma va diplomatik ohang bo‘lsin. Shundan keyin 15 savollik testni topshiring. Kursni tugatganingiz bilan tabriklaymiz!

options: If you commit to two years, we would reduce the unit price.
The best alternative if no deal is reached

quiz.why_uz: Aniq va harakatga chaqiruvchi mavzu eng yaxshi.

quiz.q: Which sentence is best for closing an email?
options: Could you let me have your comments by Friday?

quiz.q: ‘If you ___ the contract, you may be sued.’
Which is the most diplomatic way to disagree?
